video_title: Head Coach Jordan Ott Postgame Media Availability | Phoenix Suns | 10-26-26

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the Suns' defensive struggles and lack of control
quotes.excerpt: the start of it we just weren't quite able to get the ball under control
quotes.quote: Our group, we talk a lot about our defensive intensity, our defensive intent. The start of it we just weren't quite able to get the ball under control. So, guard the basketball, pick-and-roll defense, we tried a couple different things, tried to keep it under control. That's where it always starts with us. If we can't get the ball under control and they get into our paint, they get a little rhythm. That's what it felt like. We tried to get them out of it, I thought we did a good job on the glass at times, we kind of fixed that for a certain period of time, and then they get you to the free-throw line. There's just multiple ways that they can really attack your defense, we weren't quite able to get it under control tonight.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns defensive struggles tonight started with an inability to get the ball under control. We just were not quite able to get the ball under control and they get into our paint and they get a little rhythm.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott discusses the team's defensive struggles and inability to control the ball during the postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on Devin Booker's performance and defensive attention
quotes.excerpt: they send you multiple bodies, you know, at different times of the game
quotes.quote: I think we got to see some of that early, and give them credit. That's what they do. They send you multiple bodies, you know, at different times of the game. It felt like there was three guys on him. The way he pass it out, whether we got an opportunity right from that, or the pass-pass, which we talked a lot about to try to put them in closeouts, he even had to handle a lot in zone. So, I think it's a good lesson for us seeing some film on some defenses like that, again, early in this season.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the defensive attention Devin Booker faced tonight. It felt like there was three guys on him. We talked a lot about the pass-pass to try to put them in closeouts.

structured.context: Jordan Ott explains how the opposing defense focused on Devin Booker by sending multiple defenders at him throughout the game.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the Suns' offensive intent and shooting strategy
quotes.excerpt: we got some high-quality looks, so that's what we're always searching
quotes.quote: I thought we got some high-quality looks, so that's what we're always searching. Obviously, we want our best player to be in attack mode. Sometimes when they're showing you bodies like that, the best read is just to make the next one. Our quality of looks were pretty good. We got 53s up against this group, that's kind of what you want to do. You want to shoot as many 3s as you can get, a bunch of catch-and-shoot, I think it was 35 or 37 catch-and-shoot. So, I think overall, the intent of what we're trying to do offensively is there.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott is happy with the Suns offensive intent despite the result. We got 53s up against this group. That is kind of what you want to do. You want to shoot as many 3s as you can get.

structured.context: Jordan Ott evaluates the team's offensive performance and their strategy to generate high-quality three-point shots.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the Suns' search for a five-man lineup
quotes.excerpt: we need 48 minutes of a great five-man play
quotes.quote: We're searching. We're searching for that. We need 48 minutes of a great five-man play, like we've talked about since the injuries. Their size, you know, at times when they're catching it over top of us, our guys are fighting like hell to try to get the rebound or try to keep them from just tipping it in. You feel for them. You feel for them there. So that's why we go back big. Again, our pick-and-roll defense, again, that's another reason why we decided just to switch some of that. We're going to keep searching. We need to find that 48 minutes of great center play.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott admits the Suns are still searching for a consistent five-man lineup in the wake of recent injuries. We need 48 minutes of great center play. We are going to keep searching.

structured.context: Jordan Ott discusses the team's ongoing search for a consistent five-man lineup and the challenges posed by injuries.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordan Ott on the development of the team's young players
quotes.excerpt: he's catching a lot out of him at a time
quotes.quote: I don't think this play is not game-by-game for him. It's a long scope of who we believe he can be and really will be. He's catching a lot out of him at a time. Tonight was zone, or playing pick-and-roll defense. We changed our pick-and-roll to this to a different coverage to try to handle what they were doing to attack us. So, those two guys are fantastic with the ball in their hands. Hartenstein's an elite screener, so you're fighting to try to take them away from the screen at times, or over the top, and they're an elite screener. So, a lot of things that man-man is learning on the fly, and we'll be right with him every step of the way.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott on the development of his young players. I do not think this play is game-by-game for him. It is a long scope of who we believe he can be and really will be.

structured.context: Jordan Ott comments on the development of young players and the difficulty of defending against elite screeners like Isaiah Hartenstein.
